# unifi_switch_lags (Data Source)

Lists switch link-aggregation groups (LAGs) on a site via the UniFi **Official API** (`integration/v1`). Read-only. Requires a controller running version 10.1.78 or later with API-key authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List switch link-aggregation groups (LAGs) on the site (Official API).
# The singular unifi_switch_lag data source fetches one by id.
data "unifi_switch_lags" "all" {}

# Device-based LAGs (LOCAL, MULTI_CHASSIS) identify members by device_id;
# SWITCH_STACK LAGs identify them by stack unit (unit_id, unit_mac_address).
output "lag_members" {
  value = {
    for l in data.unifi_switch_lags.all.lags : l.id => [
      for m in l.members : l.type == "SWITCH_STACK" ? "unit ${m.unit_id}: ${join(",", m.port_idxs)}" : "device ${m.device_id}: ${join(",", m.port_idxs)}"
    ]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) An optional Official-API filter expression applied server-side when listing switch LAGs.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site to query. If not specified, the provider's default site is used.

### Read-Only

- `lags` (Attributes List) The switch LAGs defined on the site. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--lags))

<a id="nestedatt--lags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `lags`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The UUID of the LAG.
- `json` (String) The full LAG details serialized as a JSON string.
- `members` (Attributes List) The LAG members, read from the type-specific LAG variant. Empty when the controller reports none or the LAG type is not recognized. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--lags--members))
- `metadata_origin` (String) The origin of the LAG entity (e.g. `USER_DEFINED`).
- `type` (String) The LAG type: `LOCAL` (ports on one switch), `MULTI_CHASSIS` (MC-LAG across two switches) or `SWITCH_STACK` (ports across units of a switch stack).

<a id="nestedatt--lags--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `lags.members`

Read-Only:

- `device_id` (String) The UUID of the member device, for `LOCAL` and `MULTI_CHASSIS` LAGs. Null for `SWITCH_STACK` LAGs.
- `port_idxs` (List of Number) The aggregated port indexes on the member device or unit.
- `unit_id` (Number) The stack unit id of the member (see `units` on `unifi_switch_stack`), for `SWITCH_STACK` LAGs. Null otherwise.
- `unit_mac_address` (String) The MAC address of the member stack unit, for `SWITCH_STACK` LAGs. Null otherwise.
